title.purpose: Space name atop the sheet; place name in detail.

body.purpose: Row names, note text, inputs, text buttons.

body-emphasis.purpose: Empty-state headings and the primary button.

subhead.purpose: Metadata lines, distances, status text; 600 for section headings.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Phone sheet over the map. Dark: 0 -1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06), 0 -8px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5).

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: Selected segment in the segmented control.

shadows.name: pin-shadow
shadows.value: circle #000 at 22% opacity, radius 10, blur 0.6, translate 0 1.5px
shadows.purpose: Under every map pin (Mapbox paint, not CSS).

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.purpose: Sheet moving to a detent; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. None while dragging.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sheet becomes a 400px left column beside the map.

mapPaint.baseStyle: mapbox light-v11 / dark-v11, chosen at load

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter and category picker; blue when pressed, category dot inside.
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap} .ds-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:36px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--fill,#e9e9ee);color:var(--foreground,#1c1c1e);font:500 15px/1 inherit;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer} .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent,#0062cc);color:#fff} .ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0062cc);outline-offset:2px} .ds-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:9999px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255/.7)} .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] .ds-dot{box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px #fff}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Fill-grey search field under the sheet title.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m15.5 15.5 5 5"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Find a place to save, near here" aria-label="Find a place to save"></label>
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;height:40px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--fill,#e9e9ee);color:var(--secondary,#636366)} .ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;padding-left:8px;font:400 17px inherit;font-family:inherit;color:var(--foreground,#1c1c1e);outline:none;caret-color:var(--accent,#0062cc)} .ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--secondary,#636366)} .ds-search:focus-within{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent,#0062cc)}

components.name: Text Field

components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px} .ds-field span{font-size:13px;color:var(--secondary,#636366)} .ds-field input{height:44px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--fill,#e9e9ee);font:400 17px inherit;font-family:inherit;color:var(--foreground,#1c1c1e);outline:none;caret-color:var(--accent,#0062cc)} .ds-field input:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent,#0062cc)}

components.description: Blue filled button for the one committing action.
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-btn-primary{height:44px;min-width:160px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--accent,#0062cc);color:#fff;font:600 17px inherit;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer} .ds-btn-primary:active{opacity:.8} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0062cc);outline-offset:2px}

components.description: Want/Been switch in the place detail.
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding:2px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--fill,#e9e9ee);width:320px} .ds-seg button{height:32px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;font:500 15px inherit;font-family:inherit;color:var(--foreground,#1c1c1e);cursor:pointer} .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--background,#fff);font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0/.12)} .ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0062cc);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Place Row
components.description: Pool list row: category dot, name, metadata line, distance; inset hairline.
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;width:375px;border-top:1px solid var(--separator,#dcdce1);background:var(--background,#fff)} .ds-row{display:flex;width:100%;align-items:stretch;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;text-align:left;font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;color:var(--foreground,#1c1c1e)} .ds-row:hover,.ds-row:focus-visible{background:var(--grouped,#f2f2f7)} .ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0062cc);outline-offset:-2px} .ds-row:active{background:var(--fill,#e9e9ee)} .ds-lead{display:flex;width:40px;flex-shrink:0;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding-left:4px} .ds-rdot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:9999px} .ds-body{display:flex;flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:56px;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 16px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--separator,#dcdce1)} .ds-text{flex:1;min-width:0} .ds-name{display:block;font-size:17px;line-height:1.375;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis} .ds-meta{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.375;color:var(--secondary,#636366)} .ds-dist{font-size:15px;color:var(--secondary,#636366);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Sheet Header
components.description: Top of the phone sheet: grabber, large title with the Trips link.
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif;} .ds-sheet{width:375px;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;background:var(--background,#fff);box-shadow:0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0/.04),0 -8px 28px rgb(0 0 0/.12);padding-bottom:12px} .ds-grab{display:flex;height:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:center} .ds-grab span{width:36px;height:5px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--separator,#dcdce1)} .ds-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 16px} .ds-head h1{margin:0;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--foreground,#1c1c1e)} .ds-head a{font-size:17px;color:var(--accent,#0062cc);text-decoration:none} .ds-head a:hover{opacity:.7} .ds-head a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0062cc);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
Trips is meant to look like it shipped with the phone. The whole app follows the standard look of its category on purpose (PRODUCT.md, Brand Commitments): an iPhone and Mac maps app, with Apple Maps as the bar for craft. Conventions are kept, not reinvented. The care goes into getting the details right: Apple's system type, Apple's grouped greys, one system blue, hairline separators, a sheet you drag between three heights, and a segmented control.

The map is the main view and is not styled. Mapbox's light and dark base maps carry the place, and the app adds two things on top: category-coloured pins and the sheet (on a laptop, the list column). Everything chrome-like is quiet grey, so the only colours you notice are the category dots and the one blue that marks what is selected or tappable.

The layout is dense the way a native list is dense: 17px rows with a 15px line under them, 56px tall on a phone and 48px on a laptop, with separators that start where the text starts rather than under the dot.
keyCharacteristics: System sans everywhere (SF on Apple devices); there is no brand typeface.
Grouped-background greys for fills, one blue for selection, controls and links.
Category dots are the only other colour, on pins, rows and chips.
Hairline separators, inset to the text.
A bottom sheet with a grabber and three heights on phones; a fixed 400px column on laptops.
Dark mode follows the system through the same named tokens.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means tappable or selected. Nothing decorative is blue, and nothing tappable gets a second accent colour.

rules.name: The Dots Only Rule
rules.body: Category colour only appears as a dot or a pin. A category never tints a row, a fill or any text.

rules.name: The Token Mirror Rule
rules.body: The map draws outside CSS, so `pool-map.tsx` repeats the light and dark accent hex values by hand. Any change to `--accent` must be made in both places.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Distances and counts use tabular numerals so a column of "80 m" and "200 m" lines up.

rules.name: The Middle Dot Rule
rules.body: Metadata joins with " · " in one secondary line (category, then status or city, then distance), never as separate badges.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: Separate things with a fill step or a hairline before you reach for a shadow. Shadows belong to things that float over the map.

dos: **Do** use the platform convention first; if Apple Maps or iOS has a standard control for it, use that look (segmented control, grouped list, sheet with grabber, fill-grey search field).
**Do** keep blue for selection, focus and tappable things only.
**Do** show categories as dots (12px in rows, 10px in chips, 8px-radius pins), not as text or fill colour.
**Do** use `--background`, `--grouped`, `--fill` and `--separator` for every surface so dark mode keeps working.
**Do** use the 17 / 15 / 13 px sizes and tabular numerals for distances and counts.
**Do** put any new colour or accent change in `globals.css` and mirror it in `pool-map.tsx`.
donts: **Don't** add a brand typeface or display face; the app uses the system sans on purpose.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or colour-coded fills.
**Don't** use borders around controls; separate with fill steps and hairlines.
**Don't** add hard or offset shadows; the only shadows are the soft ones listed under Elevation & Depth.
**Don't** add small uppercase labels above titles; section headings are plain 15px semibold words.
